description: Golden fixture for the design lists-graph.md 4.2 total order. Each row carries created/updated/lastActivityEvent as RFC3339Nano strings (lastActivityEvent empty means none, i.e. the COALESCE/'0001' NULL case). expectedUpdatedDesc/Asc and expectedCreatedDesc/Asc are the row IDs in the order agentsort.SortRows must produce for sort=updated and sort=created respectively. The sub-second trailing-zero-fraction cases (ids t1/t2) are deliberately chosen so that string (localeCompare) order would misorder them, pinning the true-time ordering design 4.2 requires as a documented behaviour change.
